methodology.parameters: Frozen v6 constants; no result-driven tuning.
methodology.decision_clock: one plan at Bangkok midnight after the 23:00 H1 closes
methodology.signal_window: only rows at or before cutoff are supplied to build()
methodology.forward_window: next 24 closed H1 bars, excluded from signal construction
methodology.oco: first strict close crossing a trigger cancels the opposite scenario
methodology.retest: subsequent closed H1 range must touch entry zone; worst boundary fill
methodology.invalidation: after trigger and before retest, only a closed H1 beyond SL invalidates
methodology.exit: TP1/TP2 all-in TP/SL sensitivity only; same-H1 stop+target is ambiguous and excluded
